clauses.title: CL-D116 records the parent's subject, the convention and its check
clauses.section: ## CL-D116 — The parent writes the autofix correction subject; the driver checks it against the commit convention
requires: the third refusal stops `BLOCKED` with `commit_subject_refused`, before any writer launch or commit
Imperative mood is the gates' to judge; nothing else is checked.
The aggregate driver alarm rises from 110,000 to 120,000 bytes

clauses.title: The driver asks for the subject, checks it, and stops at the third refusal
requires: if (r.problem && !('config' in r)) return { problem: r.problem };
const own = validation.config?.commit !== undefined || validation.source === 'operator configuration', r = own ? validation : operator()
if (ids.some((id) => m[3].includes(id))) return 'the summary describes the change, not a finding id';

clauses.title: Each correction bullet is folded to one line
The parent writes only the subject a MESSAGE line asks for
requires: When a line begins `MESSAGE:` instead, write the one subject line it asks for from the corrections listed under it
you write only the subject, never the body or the issue number
